IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Haigh, Nixon, Green, Lantz, Priest and Schindler

Bill.BriefDescription: Limiting the effect of construction contract provisions affecting the claim rights of contractors.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the preservation of claim rights of acontractor, subcontractor, or supplier on construction contracts;amending RCW 4.24.370 and 4.24.380; and adding a new section to chapter4.24 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 4.24 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any clause in a construction contract, as defined in RCW 4.24.370,that purports to waive, release, or extinguish the claim rights of acontractor, subcontractor, or supplier to damages or an equitableadjustment based on failure to submit claim notice or claimrelateddocumentation in a specified time frame or form is enforceable to theextent that the party failing to receive such notice or documentationwas prejudiced thereby.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 4.24.370 and 1979 ex.s. c 264 s 2 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: "Construction contract" for purposes of RCW 4.24.360 and section 1of this act means any contract or agreement for the construction, p. 1 HB 1613alteration, repair, addition to, subtraction from, improvement to, ormaintenance of, any building, highway, road, railroad, excavation, orother structure, project, development, or improvement attached to realestate, including moving and demolition in connection therewith.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 4.24.380 and 1979 ex.s. c 264 s 3 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The provisions of RCW 4.24.360 shall apply to contracts oragreements entered into after September 1, 1979. (2) The provisions of section 1 of this act shall apply tocontracts or agreements entered into on or after the effective date ofthis act.
